observations: Photo 0 shows a car engine bay/engine assembly on a stand or floor, with visible intake/exhaust components, belts/pulleys, and wiring/harness.
No clear Toyota branding, engine code, VIN plate, or model year markings are readable in the photo.
No clear evidence of mileage, whether it was opened, or any test results (e.g., running video, diagnostic printout) is visible.

claims.claim: Toyota camry Engine 5x old model direct with guarantee
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a readable Toyota/Camry identification, engine code, or any guarantee document.
Photo 0 shows no import documents, shipping labels, or country-of-origin markings.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 is a static image; it does not show a running test, diagnostic scan, or mileage/engine history proof.

risks.risk: Engine identification mismatch (not actually a Camry engine, wrong engine family/variant).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the engine ID/engine code plate (or stamped code) and the full engine label area; plus a photo of the engine from multiple angles showing the code.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown used engine (worst case: not confirmed compatible), with no guarantee of working condition.

risks.risk: Not actually tested/working (could have internal issues not visible in a photo).
risks.proof: Short video of the engine running from cold start, plus a diagnostic scan report (OBD) showing no critical faults.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working/untested until proven.

risks.risk: “No knock” claim may be false or intermittent.
risks.proof: Running video at idle and at a light rev (with audio), ideally showing stable sound and no knocking.

risks.risk: “Never opened” and “low mileage” may be untrue.
risks.proof: Photos of the cylinder head cover/valve cover area, timing cover area (if accessible), and any tamper marks; plus mileage proof from the donor vehicle documents.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as opened/unknown mileage risk (worst case: higher wear).

risks.risk: Missing parts or incomplete engine kit (alternator/AC compressor/ECU/sensors may be missing).
risks.proof: Photo list showing all included components laid out (starter, alternator, AC compressor, ECU/ECM, sensors, hoses, mounts) and a checklist.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate or stamped engine code (the part that uniquely identifies the engine).
Send a video of the engine running (cold start if possible) with audio to confirm no knock.
Send an OBD/diagnostic scan screenshot or printout showing fault codes (and ideally readiness status).
Send import proof (Belgium/tokunbo documents) or at least the shipping/receipt page.
Send photos of all included parts (ECU/ECM, alternator, starter, sensors, mounts, hoses) and confirm what is included/excluded.
response.reason: The photo shows an engine assembly but does not allow reliable identification of the exact Camry engine variant, nor does it prove the seller’s working/no-knock/low-mileage/never-opened claims. To price safely, you need engine-code identification and proof of running/diagnostics.
